svg.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace
svg.title: Waveform of the demo VCD trace
svg.desc: Overview of the full 5339-cycle VCD trace and a 40-cycle zoom of clk, tick_valid and ofi.
svg.text: Waveform of the trace the demo writes (fpga_sim_core.vcd)
parsed from the real VCD; simulated cycles, synthetic input, not a hardware measurement
zoom: cycles 6-45 (18.6-139.6 ns, from VCD timestamps)
tick_valid is the demo's wire_busy(): high while the PCS stage holds a message. ofi is the last OFI value (signed 32-bit, shares).
1 cycle = 3103030 fs in the VCD (rounded); clk is drawn with the 50% duty the logger writes.
